answer: Attention Ledger Requirement. Each agent identity must maintain a verifiable log of timed, task-relevant responses, and privileges scale only after sustained activity crosses a rolling threshold. An attacker must fund real compute and human oversight for every identity across many cycles, paying the same attention cost as a legitimate operator. Sybil clusters stall below the threshold before reaching their operational zenith. Gains stay bounded by a dune of decaying credit when activity lapses, and each identity resets at dawn of the next window.
